FULL SALES SCRIPT - IL JUNE 2026 (operator) - KEEP OPEN WHILE YOU CALL

1 - OPEN

Heeey [Homeowner]? Hey [Homeowner], this is [Your Name].

2 - WHY YOU'RE CALLING

We're doing some work over on [Street Name] for an approved local solar offer. I'll only use the vendor/program name your company approved for this shift.

Ask: Have you looked at solar for this home yet — or heard of the approved program we're calling about?

3 - MOST PEOPLE HAVEN'T

Most people haven't, and that's exactly why I'm calling.

4 - QUICK REASON

the utility rates keep going up, the grid is under a lot of demand, and qualified homes can get panels without taking out a loan and without paying out of pocket for the equipment.

5 - NOT SELLING PANELS TODAY

I'm not calling to sell you panels today. We're simply checking if your home qualifies. If it does, we schedule a quick visit so you can see a side-by-side savings projection in black and white.

6 - SIMPLE VERSION

Here's the simple version: explain only the ownership, maintenance, and bill model from your approved vendor packet. Do not invent financing, ownership, or utility partnership claims.

7 - SAME HOUSE / SAME POWER / LOWER RATE

Same house. Same power. Lower rate.

8 - SOFT ASK

Would you at least be open to checking if your home qualifies?

If yes: highest bill through the year? How long ago did you buy the home? Then book specialist side-by-side.

9 - BOOK + BILL

I can get that side-by-side set up. Is earlier or later usually better for you?

Lock day/time/format. Text for usage bar + recent charges.

10 - OBJECTIONS

"Totally fair — that's why this step is just checking qualification and a written side-by-side, not a decision today."

FUNDAMENTALS OF RAPPORT - USE ON EVERY CALL (first 90 seconds)

R1 - NAME (3x / first 2 min)

Say their first name on the hello, once when you bridge, once before your first real question. Stop there. More than that sounds salesy.

R2 - PACE + VOLUME MATCH

Match their speed within about 15%. Match volume one notch. If they are calm, drop to a late-night DJ voice. Do not overpower a quiet homeowner.

R3 - MIRROR LAST 2-3 WORDS

When they finish a thought, repeat their last 2-3 words with a slight upward tone, then shut up. Let them keep talking. That is discovery, not a trick.

R4 - ENERGY MATCH

Friendly opener is fine (Heeey). If they answer flat or busy, immediately tone down. Match their energy before you pitch the approved offer.

R5 - LISTEN BEFORE EXPLAIN

Ask if they know the approved program/offer. Hear the answer fully. Only then give the quick reason. Never talk over them.

R6 - LABEL THE FEELING

If they push back: "Sounds like the timing is the issue" / "It seems like you already got numbers." Label first, answer second.

R7 - EARN THE NEXT STEP

Rapport goal is not friendship. Goal is enough trust to check qualification and book a written side-by-side. Soft ask after they feel heard.

Live check: name used? pace matched? at least one mirror? listened before the explain? Then continue ForgeFront script step 4+.
APPROVED OFFER TRUTH (do not invent beyond vendor packet)

WHAT IT IS

Use only the program/offer description from the approved vendor packet for this shift. If it is not in the packet, do not say it.

SAY THIS (SAFE)

"I can walk you through the approved offer and whether this home even qualifies — no pressure to buy on this call."

DO NOT CLAIM

Do not invent savings percentages, free panels, loan terms, ownership language, or utility partnerships beyond approved materials.

TOMORROW NOON PACK — 6 PREQUALS + CLOSE-THE-BOX (Magic Minutes)

BOOT

Headset on · Roam pins · Dialer alone · Calendar+maps together · ForgeFront LINK ROAM AUDIO → MIC+ROAM

P1 HOME OWNER

Confirm homeowner / decision path before you sell the dream.

P2 STRUCTURE

House, townhome, or duplex only. No apartments, condos, mobiles.

P3 BILL

Electric averages over $100/month.

P4 SUN

Roof sun OK — check Project Sunroof / maps while talking.

P5 MOBILE TEXTS

Number that receives confirmation texts.

P6 EMAIL

Confirm carefully. Do not embarrass them into a hangup.

CLOSE THE BOX

Acknowledge → one-line rebuttal → close box → keep walking. Do not open every objection box.

OWNERSHIP PUSHBACK

Same as the dish or the pole outside — service gear, not something you buy. Cancel and they take it back.

BOOK ONLY IF GREEN

Weak sets explode on verification. Notes: bill ballpark, sun/roof, motivation, who else on title.

Calendar: the utility top-left · Firstletter-only names · Dialer dispositions every hangup · personal callback box for YOUR agenda.
operator FUNDAMENTALS — ASSUME CUSTOMER + SHORT REBUTTALS

F1 ALREADY YOUR CUSTOMER

Before you pick up: assume they are already a customer. Talk like a regular, not a stranger.

F2 ENERGY TRANSFER

Body language / confidence transfers on the phone. Warmth of a 15-year regular.

F3 STRUCTURE

Script + prequals. Do not wander the hallway opening boxes.

F4 RAPPORT WHILE YOU QUALIFY

Name, pace match, listen — then qualify. Soft ask after they feel heard.

F5 SHORT SWEET REBUTTALS

Being confident is good. Having a tight answer for everything is better. Keep it short.

F6 ASSURED FINISH

Only book when the quality checklist is green. Protect verification.
